lines.t: Look at the stars, look how they shine tonight
Exalting Your name, filling the dark with light
And all that You made, a masterpiece in view
Yeah, they were made for You
And Your grace shines bright
Oh, Your love is like a guiding light
You washed my soul and made it white
Oh, Your grace shines bright
I drew a line, I tried to walk alone
I lost my way, but You called me home
You took my cross, You took the heavy load
And walked this broken road
And Your grace shines bright
Oh, Your love is like a guiding light
You washed my soul and made it white
Oh, Your grace shines bright
It's true, look how You came for me
Look how You set me free
Look how You bled for me
It's true, look how You care for me
Look at the stars, look how they shine for You
And everything You do
Oh, Your grace shines bright
